An [[Alien/Legends|alien]] '''individual''' acted as an agent of [[Raskar]] and was a frequent occupant at the criminal hideaway, [[Junkfort Station/Legends|Junkfort Station]]. In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], the alien talked with the Wookiee [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] and informed him about a potential lead to the [[power gem]] at [[Antipose]]. It was largely because of this that Chewbacca was delayed in saving [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] from would-be assassins of [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]]. Afterwards, he contacted Raskar about Han and Chewbacca's impending arrival at Antipose, and started undergoing a laughing fit for all of the bar to hear, indicating that while he was honest about the power gem's existence, he believed that Han and Chewbacca didn't stand a chance at retrieving it.

==Personality and traits==
According to the other barflies, the spacer rarely laughed unless it was at someone else's expense.
